articles.title: Scientists Name the 'Chunkiest' Squid Relative Ever Found
articles.summary: Fossils from Wyoming reveal a new 160-million-year-old squid relative with the thickest, chunkiest body part of its kind ever found.

articles.title: A Healthy 'Twin' Can Help Bleached Coral Recover
articles.summary: In lab tests, bleached corals fully recovered in seven weeks after touching healthy, genetically identical coral pieces.

articles.title: Hidden Cracks Help Explain a Mystery on Asteroid Bennu
articles.summary: Samples from asteroid Bennu reveal rocks full of tiny cracks, helping explain why its boulder-covered surface cools so quickly.
